title: An owner who asks for a new Space gets a new Space, not the launch of the one they already have

source.ref: Owner 2026-11-19: "Do a super sweep 5000 of the site... Make sure everything is complete, fully evolved and validated." Found by the end to end sweep.

detail: LIVE-2392 made a running launch with no Space take the person's one Space, on /launch and wherever the rail and the feed read the setup list. /spaces/new sends new=1 to /launch/start, which started a launch with no Space and no mark, so the next read attached the owner's existing Space and marked its Spotlight published: an owner of exactly one Space could never start a second, and the 'Which Space is this for? A new one' choice never showed. DONE 2026-11-19: /launch/start, for someone who already owns a Space and asked for a new one, saves the launch as the builder's (resume phase builder), the one mark the adopt rule leaves alone; /launch then opens /create-a-space?new=1 as it already did for a builder launch. A first Space is unchanged.

verify.note: Passes while the consequence in the title holds.
